get.description:
Dependency health check.

Checks the database (a hard dependency -- MDU cannot function without
it) and GC Shakti reachability (informational -- its actual impact on
operations is governed separately by GC_SHAKTI_MODE, see Integration
Specification v1 Section 17). Overall status is "healthy" only if the
database check passes; GC Shakti being unreachable is reported but does
not by itself make the service unhealthy, since fail_open mode is
designed to keep operating without it. Returns HTTP 503 when unhealthy
so uptime monitors and load balancers key off the status code, not just
the body.

Structured operational metrics.

Requires a valid API key (any role) -- unlike / and /health, this is
not fully open, since request-volume-by-endpoint data is more
operationally sensitive. Returns an in-process snapshot: request counts
and latency per endpoint since the current process started, plus
overall status code distribution. This resets on process restart --
for durable historical data, see /api/v1/audit/logs and
/api/v1/audit/consumption, which persist to the database.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Registry API key, sent in the X-API-Key header. Keys are issued per consumer and carry one of four roles: VIEWER (read only), CONTRIBUTOR (read and write), GOVERNANCE_REVIEWER (trust transitions, schema freeze, onboarding review) and REGISTRY_ADMIN (audit endpoints). Requests without a valid key receive HTTP 401; requests whose role is insufficient receive HTTP 403.
